_comment: Hand-authored metadata that cannot be inferred automatically from pixel data alone (animation rows, tile grid size). Keyed by generated asset id. Merged onto the auto-discovered manifest entry by scripts/generate-assets.mjs. Frame layout was determined by visual inspection of the Cute Fantasy sprite sheets. Asset ids mirror the folder layout under assets/cute-fantasy-rpg/: tilesets/, characters/{player,enemies,animals}/, props/{buildings/}, animations/, ui/.

characters/player/player._comment: This sheet only has 6 real movement rows (0-5) — verified by visually inspecting every row/frame (see docs/Architecture.md 'Sprite sheet notes'). Rows 6-8 are attack/action poses (sword frames) and row 9 is a faint/death pose, not walk cycles. There is no dedicated right-facing row: right movement is idle-left/walk-left played with the sprite horizontally flipped (see AnimatedActor.playAnim).

_comment_agent_variants: The nine agent-specific sheets below (player-scout, player-atlas, ...) are palette-swapped copies of characters/player/player.png — same 6-row layout, just hair/shirt/pants hue-shifted per agent so each of the nine AI employees reads as visually distinct instead of sharing one sprite with only a whole-image tint (see AgentNPC.ts / AgentProfiles.ts). Generated by a one-off PIL script, not hand-drawn — hair/shirt/pants pixels were matched by color proximity to the base sheet's known anchor colors and hue-rotated; giving the raw modular character rig (Player_Base + Chest/Hair/Legs layers) in the premium pack a try first, but its ~112-row animation layout didn't match this project's verified 6-row convention and reverse-engineering it reliably wasn't feasible without risking a broken walk cycle.
_comment_meridian: v0.7 Feature 24 — the tenth agent (Meridian, CIO), added the same way as the original nine (see _comment_agent_variants above): a palette-swapped copy of characters/player/player.png, generated by inspecting which base-sheet colors the nine existing variants actually recolor (hair + shirt + pants) vs. which they always leave untouched (skin, outline, shadow), then hand-picking a distinguished slate-grey hair / gold-amber shirt / charcoal-pants combination for an executive read, distinct from all nine existing agents' tints.

tilesets/cobblestone-grey._comment: User-picked cell (col 1, row 5) from an uploaded Wood_Floor_Tiles.png reference sheet — a cool grey square-tile pattern that reads as cobblestone. Same cell used once before as tilesets/wood-floor, then swapped out for a dirt path to match a different reference screenshot; brought back at the user's request when the dirt path 'didn't look nice.' Confirmed to tile with zero seams before use.

props/pond-curved._comment: Cute Fantasy premium pack — the top-left 48x48 blob cropped from tilesets/water-tile's source sheet (Water_Tile.png). That sheet turns out to be a pre-composed organic pond graphic, not a repeating tile: its opaque corner pixels are the exact same green as tilesets/grass-middle, so it drops onto the ground layer with no visible seam.

props/small-spruce-tree._comment: Middle frame cropped from a 3-frame sheet (frame 0 was a young sapling stage, frames 1-2 were mature-tree sway variants).

props/small-fruit-tree._comment: Middle frame cropped from a 3-frame sheet, same reasoning as small-spruce-tree.

props/dock._comment: Cropped from bridge-wood.png's middle bridge segment — used as a small pond dock, not a river crossing.

props/hedge-tiles._comment: Cute Fantasy premium pack, 4x4 grid (16 frames, row-major). Col 0 is a narrow vertical hedge column (frame 0 = top cap, 4/8 = fill, 12 = bottom cap); cols 1-3 are full-width hedge block variants with the same cap/fill/fill/cap pattern. Col-0 pieces are used unrotated for vertical hedge runs and rotated 90° for horizontal ones.

props/fountain._comment: Cute Fantasy premium pack. Frame 0 is a flat stone basin pool, frame 1 a tiered spouting fountain — clean 40px split confirmed against the source sheet's transparent gap.

props/market-stalls._comment: Cute Fantasy premium pack, 4 color variants (red/green/blue/orange striped awnings) frame-indexed 0-3.

props/boat._comment: Small rowboat sitting in shallow water — floats near the pond dock.

props/buildings/church-red-front._comment: Cropped from Church_Red.png's 4-frame sheet (Cute Fantasy premium pack) — one 112x144 frame with the door and unlit windows, matching the daytime look of every other building.

props/buildings/greenhouse-wood-front._comment: Cropped from GreenHouse_Wood.png's 4-frame sheet (Cute Fantasy premium pack) — the front-facing frame with a visible door.

animations/lillypad-green-anim._comment: Cute Fantasy premium pack, 8-frame horizontal strip — a lilypad gently bobbing on the water.

animations/cattail-anim._comment: Cute Fantasy premium pack, 8-frame horizontal strip — reeds swaying at the pond's edge.

animations/grass-sway-anim._comment: Cute Fantasy premium pack, 8-frame horizontal strip — a grass tuft swaying in the breeze.

animations/lamppost-glow-anim._comment: Cute Fantasy premium pack, 6-frame horizontal strip (row 0 of a 6x18 grid) — a lamppost with a gently flickering flame.

ui/resources-icons-outline._comment: Cute Fantasy premium pack, 6x6 grid of resource icons. Staged for future in-game UI use, not yet drawn anywhere.

ui/tool-icons-outline._comment: Cute Fantasy premium pack, 10x1 strip of tool icons. Staged for future in-game UI use, not yet drawn anywhere.

characters/animals/chicken/chicken._comment: This file is actually a 2x2 grid of 4 poses, not a single sprite — confirmed by visual inspection when first wiring an animal into a scene. Use chicken-idle (cropped single frame) instead of this one for in-world rendering.

characters/animals/chicken/chicken-idle._comment: Top-left frame cropped from chicken.png's 2x2 pose grid.

characters/animals/duck/duck-idle._comment: One clean frame cropped from an 8x20 pose/animation grid — same reasoning as chicken-idle.
